'''Clan Moxla''' was a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] family line. Members of the family distinguished themselves with a black patterned [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] across their cheeks. They had a historical feud with [[Clan Konshi]]. This led to the phrase, "Never trust a Konshi," used by some of the Moxla clan.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Larin Moxla]] joined forces with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Shigar Konshi]] and did not let the clan feud affect their relationship.
